import sys, re
text = sys.stdin.read()
# Find top-level frames (direct children of page 0:1)
# Look for frames at the top of the hierarchy - get all frames with their names
# Better: extract frames whose parent is 0:1
# Simpler: find tag names with id pattern '1:' followed by small numbers indicating top-level
matches = re.findall(r'<(frame|section)\s+id=\"([^\"]+)\"\s+name=\"([^\"]+)\"', text)
# Print frames containing keywords
keywords = ['목업','Mockup','iPhone','원페이지','멀티','예시','정답','샘플','RSVP','프로필','템플릿','썸네일','블로그']
seen = set()
for tag, fid, name in matches:
    for kw in keywords:
        if kw.lower() in name.lower():
            key = (fid, name)
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                print(f'{tag} {fid}: {name}')
            break
"
